_comment: §10.2 Bedrock classifier labels + §10.3 priority ranking. COLLAB removed per v13 §5.1 — firm-to-firm collaboration approaches classify as VENDOR.

priority_ranking.label: CLIENT
priority_ranking.sla: Acknowledgement within 2 hours; BD routing within 4 hours.

priority_ranking.label: JOB
priority_ranking.sla: Acknowledgement within 24 hours; HR routing within 3 days.

priority_ranking.label: INTERN
priority_ranking.sla: Acknowledgement within 24 hours; HR routing within 5 days.

priority_ranking.label: PRESS
priority_ranking.sla: Human reply within 24 hours. HIGH brand value.

priority_ranking.label: VENDOR
priority_ranking.sla: Duplicate check; archive. Includes firm-to-firm collaboration approaches.

bedrock_system_prompt: You are a single-label email classifier for an architecture and interior design studio. Read the subject line and the first 200 words of the email body. Return exactly one label from this set: VENDOR | CLIENT | INTERN | JOB | PRESS | EVENT | STRATEGIC | ADMIN | INTERNAL | UNSURE. VENDOR covers vendors, suppliers, service providers, and firm-to-firm collaboration approaches alike. Return the label only. No explanation. No punctuation.
